statute: No section: the CA's answer to CA-02 keeps each GST head at its calculated value, and paise are the smallest amount held
notes: From the CA's answer to CA-02 (CA answers document, reviewed by the CA; CA details to follow): 'The taxable/basic value and the GST components shall retain their calculated values and shall not be individually rounded to the nearest rupee.' A head is rounded only to whole paise, halves away from zero. effective_from is the date this system applies the rule from (the rate table's, CA-05). Nothing here is verified.

cases.comment: 45 paise stays 45 paise; it is not rounded to 0 rupees
4.5 paise -> 5 paise, half away from zero
